name: HARTA
recent: Hartalega 于2026年11月12日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，营收同比增长19.5%，净利润同比增长79.3%，但净利润环比下降53.2%。同期，雇员公积金局（KWAP）在9月至11月间多次申报股权变动。公司于9月3日举行第20届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收同比增长19.5%，净利润同比增长79.3%。
第20届常年股东大会于2026年9月3日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
KWAP在2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 净利润环比下降53.2%，净利率从11.6%降至5.1%。
有新闻标题提及公司被下调评级，以及手套行业面临持续逆风。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度，营收为RM644.735百万，同比增长19.5%，环比增长6.4%；净利润为RM32.804百万，同比增长79.3%，环比下降53.2%；净利率为5.1%，低于上一季度的11.6%。

recent_en: Hartalega announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 12 November 2026, with revenue up 19.5% year-on-year and net profit up 79.3% year-on-year, but net profit fell 53.2% quarter-on-quarter. Meanwhile, KWAP filed multiple notifications of changes in substantial shareholder interests between September and November. The company held its 20th Annual General Meeting on 3 September 2026, where all resolutions were approved.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 19.5% year-on-year and net profit up 79.3% year-on-year.
The 20th Annual General Meeting was held on 3 September 2026, and all resolutions were approved by shareholders.
KWAP filed multiple notifications of changes in substantial shareholder interests between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Net profit fell 53.2% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin dropping from 11.6% to 5.1%.
News headlines mention a downgrade of the company and persistent headwinds in the glove sector.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM644.735 million, up 19.5% year-on-year and up 6.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM32.804 million, up 79.3% year-on-year but down 53.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.1%, lower than 11.6% in the previous quarter.
